decision_rules.gates_on_validation: IDENTICAL to v0.2 (configs/krun_one_v0_2.yaml) — nothing relaxed: CHOICE vs Krun One v0 (kb_val intents, val_hard, val_tools accuracy drop <= 0.5 pp each; OOD AUROC kb_val / val_tools drop <= 0.01; ECE kb_val / val_hard / val_tools rise <= 0.005); NOUL in_domain (seen propositions) vs best Laya budget and vs v0: ROC-AUC higher, Brier lower, ECE not higher; SCORE in_domain vs best Laya and vs v0: MAE lower, Spearman higher, ECE and NLL not higher. All noul/score references are re-measured on data v2 (Laya 1024/896, Laya 512/192, v0). NEW gate: noul ROC-AUC on the pooled UNSEEN propositions (never trained) >= the best of Laya (either budget) and v0.
decision_rules.selection: Among eligible variants: highest mean of (noul in_domain ROC-AUC, noul unseen ROC-AUC, score in_domain Spearman, mean choice accuracy over kb_val intents and val_tools). Differences < 0.003 -> smaller choice regression; still tied -> A. No eligible variant -> STOP (MODEL_PRIMITIVES_READY=false), noul/score stay private.
decision_rules.score_confidence: Public score confidence = ordinal dispersion 1 - Var_p(level) / ((K-1)/2)^2 (results/primitives_baseline/ score_confidence.md: never worse than normalized entropy, best on untrained models, penalises bimodal splits). Registered now; not re-selected on v0.3 results.
decision_rules.final: Unchanged: after results/primitives_decisions.json freezes the choice, the selected candidate is evaluated ONCE on the test sets (choice KrunBench test intents / BFCL / holdout_tools with the <= 0.5 pp gate vs v0; noul/score test incl. BoolQ / SST-5; mixed requests). MODEL_PRIMITIVES_READY requires every validation gate AND the final choice gate AND noul/score test in_domain better than Laya.
